content.text:
The corridors kept shifting. Every door I opened led to another menu labeled something almost right—"凭证" next to "事件订阅," but "用量统计" had wandered off like a stray cat. I walked through a hallway painted the color of waiting, #F5E6D3, where server fans hummed a frequency just below memory.

Someone had left a note on a floating terminal: 如何查看lark的api使用额度. The handwriting was familiar, patient, a little bewildered. I remembered asking that once, or perhaps I will ask it again in a morning that tastes like circuit boards andoolong tea.

The walls tried to help. They whispered paths that used to work—开发者后台, 凭证与成本, 用量统计—but the building had other plans. Floorplans change. Even in places built of light and logic, the furniture rearranges itself when you're not looking.

I left a bookmark for myself on the way out: sometimes the way forward is not a path but a link you paste directly into the void and hope the void remembers what you were looking for.
